title: Wire EDM of bearing retainer rings from cold-rolled beta strip
description: Wire EDM of bearing retainer rings from cold-rolled beta strip capability for titanium components
thicknessRange: Up to 300 mm (wire); up to 200 mm cavity depth (sinker)
processDescription: Wire EDM uses a continuously traveling brass or coated wire electrode under precision CNC control to erode titanium along a programmed path. Submerged in deionized water dielectric, the process cuts intricate profiles and sharp internal corners that are impossible with conventional methods, specifically for rings. Precision rings for General and Aerospace applications present unique challenges: roundness tolerance ±0.01 mm on large diameter rings (> 300 mm) and heat treatment distortion management.
heatControl: Deionized water dielectric with < 5 µS/cm conductivity and temperature control (±0.5°C). Multi-pass roughing to finishing with decreasing energy settings.
flatnessControl: Multi-pass cutting strategy and stress-relieved material for thin-walled components. Anti-vibration wire tensioning for tall cuts up to 300 mm.
capabilitiesDescription: Wire and sinker EDM capability for Wire EDM of bearing retainer rings from cold-rolled beta strip, achieving burr-free results with multi-pass finishing strategy and submerged machining.
